headline: World Bank Projects Brent Crude Oil Prices to Fall to $79 per Barrel by 2027
summary: The World Bank projects that Brent crude oil prices will decline to an average of $79 per barrel in 2027, down from $91 per barrel in 2026, driven by rising global supplies easing market tightness.
why: Oil price forecasts by major international financial institutions help energy companies, governments, and investors model future revenues, capital expenditure, and broader macroeconomic inflation trends.
